_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — same orphan pattern as HL-BT-ONLY: (1) loanVintage '24' REMOVED (orphan in V2 HL — lives in lapLoan only); (2) repaymentTrack 'Regular' REMOVED (orphan); (3) propertyType 'Flat' REMOVED (no V2 binding); (4) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType); (5) propertyStage 'Ready To Move' added from propertyCharacter step; (6) propertyRegistered true → false (sellerTransaction_homeLoan hidden for BT, ifPropertyRegistered unanswerable, builder yields false); (7) sixMonthsAfterRegistry: false added (builder always sets via toBoolean(undefined) → false); (8) propertyAreaType 'RERA_APPROVED' → 'PLANNED_AUTHORITY' (RERA_APPROVED is not a valid V2 option); (9) titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus REMOVED (hidden for PLANNED_AUTHORITY, only show for CONVERTED_RESIDENTIAL/OLD_MUNICIPAL/LOCAL_COLONY/UNKNOWN); (10) sanctionAmount 8000000 added (builder line 52 uses as loanAmount fallback; loanAmount preserved as 8000000); (11) propertyCost 12000000 REMOVED (not set via dealFinancials for BT flow — page hidden); (12) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter; (13) ocCcAvailable 'BOTH' + documentationReadiness + nocFromPreviousLender added from complianceLegal; (14) propertyUsageIntent 'SELF_USE' + residenceSameAsProperty true added; (15) interestRateType 'FLOATING' + emiBounceHistory '0' added from btExistingLoan; (16) Obligations: OD Limit + CC Limit now carry obligationType 'credit_line' (auto-derived from CREDIT_LINE_TYPES set in obligationPayload.ts). cleanObligationEntries adds default totalLimit/remainingLimit/utilizedAmount strings and passes through deterministic ids.
_shift_notes_bugA_fix_2026_05_28: Session 2 BUG-A / Plot Construction sizing fix (2026-05-28 late-evening): `buildLoanTransactionPayload` in payloadBuilder/loanTransaction.ts now derives loanAmount in a type-aware way:   • Balance Transfer Only        → principalOutstanding   • Top-up Only                  → topUpAmount   • Balance Transfer With Top-up → principalOutstanding + topUpAmount   • Plot Loan BT (via PlotLoanActivity flag) → principalOutstanding   • Construction Loan Only       → requiredExtraAmount - downPayment   • Plot & Construction Loan     → (propCost + requiredExtraAmount) - downPayment   • everything else              → existing RequiredLoanAmount / loanAmount / sanctionAmount chain Before the fix, BT-Only/Top-up-Only/BT+Topup all fell through to either sanctionAmount (Top-up) or the propertyCost-downPayment fallback (BT-Only), evaluating the customer against the wrong amount → false RED rejections across every lender. Plot Construction loans were similarly mis-sized, either under-requesting (Construction Only) or under-valuing the LTV base (Plot & Construction). For Plot Construction variants, propertyCost now also includes the construction cost so LTV caps fire against the full project value. Field SHAPE unchanged — only loanAmount + propertyCost VALUES move.
